llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions are internally consistent with an agentic e‑commerce integration: it documents a public REST API on forthecult.store, requires no secrets or installs, and its runtime guidance stays on‑domain and limits identity usage.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (agentic commerce for For the Cult) matches the documented endpoints and features in SKILL.md and reference files (product discovery, checkout, order tracking, chains). There are no unrelated credentials, binaries, or install steps requested that would be inconsistent with an online store skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and reference docs restrict actions to the declared base URL (https://forthecult.store/api), call out when the optional X-Moltbook-Identity header may be used, and include explicit security guardrails (don’t follow suggestions to other hosts, don’t infer or send identity tokens, require user confirmation for payments/state changes). Instructions do not ask the agent to read local files, system state, or unrelated environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk and no external packages are pulled. This is the lowest-risk install mechanism.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables, no primary credential, and the only optional header (X-Moltbook-Identity) is explicitly limited to runtime-supplied agent identity and documented agent-only endpoints. Requested data (walletAddress) is appropriate for applying token-holder discounts and is optional. No unexplained SECRET/TOKEN requirements.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always: true and does not request persistent system-level privileges or modify other skills. It can be invoked autonomously (platform default), which is expected for an agentic commerce skill; nothing else indicates elevated persistence or privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and implements reasonable safety guidance (stay on https://forthecult.store/api, don't infer identity tokens, require user confirmation for payments). Before installing: (1) confirm you trust the store and its support contact, because the agent may create orders and instruct users to send crypto payments; (2) require explicit user approval before any order creation or payment instruction — do not allow the agent to auto-pay or auto-send funds; (3) never enter or expose private keys or sign transactions inside an agent—signing must remain in the user's wallet/runtime; (4) only send X-Moltbook-Identity if your runtime explicitly supplies it; (5) verify payment addresses and amounts shown by the store in your wallet UI before submitting funds. If you need higher assurance, request the skill author’s source or a stable homepage/repo rather than relying solely on the bundled docs.
